author: No_Cause483
body:
[Bowl and Plate Eatery](https://yelp.to/-e1xxq77kp) in Anaheim! It’s a great Vietnamese -Thai fusion place. There coconut lemon grass noodle soup and minced meat and eggplant stir fry dish are my personal favorites.

They have some really good drinks and desserts too. They have a half green tea/ half Thai tea drink that is incredible! And their mango sticky rice is a classic that’s delicious.

author: eatalways
body: I love this place! True definition of mom and pop restaurant with delicious food in a run down strip mall
